chk_method.label: accurate
chk_method.poster_evidence: We propose LLM4AIGQ, an LLM-based solution for generating AI guidance queries tailored to users’ multi-interests. This approach segments user interests by integrating user profiles and historical interaction sequences, infers specific consumption intents for each sub-interest, and subsequently generates corresponding AIGQ. In terms of model training, we employ a post-training pipeline comprising Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), Reinforcement Learning (RL), and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to enhance the model’s capability in generating AIGQ.
